primary_metric: macro MAE, same validation folds per target/population
decision_rule: Per target: a variant is a research candidate only if it wins the majority of folds against Seasonal Naive with no >20% key-segment degradation (n>=100) and valid resources in cohort64 AND cohort128; lowest cohort64 macro MAE among those, lexical tie; otherwise seasonal_naive
group_effect_rule: A group effect is claimed only if the 95% crossed interval of macro MAE difference excludes zero and the same sign holds in most folds; otherwise inconclusive
tuning: none; feature groups at previous bounded configurations
availability: approximate +45d only; B capped at min(origin,fit_as_of); NULL preserved; no weather/GBFS/station metadata/unpublished short lags
test_policy: September 2026 already consumed; not a new independent test; no test-driven selection/promotion; strict/forward evidence absent

evaluation_weather.use: Key-segment gate and diagnostics AFTER prediction; not a feature

H1_level_shift.claim: Delayed labels leave train without the validation season; bias sign follows the validation/train level ratio across folds
H1_level_shift.expect: A cannot extrapolate an unseen month; B helps only where a published month or annual profile already carries the level
H1_level_shift.check: fold bias, fold0 delta, seasonal_month missing share

H2_sparse_station.claim: Stations with little or no train history carry excess error
H2_sparse_station.expect: B station-level history helps new/low stations more than A

H3_peak_tail.claim: actual>=20 concentrates absolute error but is a post-hoc slice; conditional means regress towards the mean
H3_peak_tail.expect: No feature group removes the tail bias
H3_peak_tail.check: actual:peak_ge20 versus predefined peak_hour; never a gate

H4_peak_calendar.claim: Predefined weekday peaks need calendar interactions
H4_peak_calendar.expect: A lowers peak_hour MAE against the same algorithm base
H4_peak_calendar.check: peak_hour fold deltas, paired A vs base

H5_stale_trend.claim: Published trend lags 45+ days and can flip at seasonal turns
H5_stale_trend.expect: B effect changes sign across folds; no stable gain from trend
H5_stale_trend.check: B vs base fold differences; group ablation

root_cause.post_hoc_note: actual>=20 is an outcome slice; not miscalibration evidence
